title: E1 Academy syllabus
note: Courses, their sequence and their lessons, built from the user guides (tools/guides/features). Each module lists guide feature ids; tools/academy/build.py packs them into lessons of about 4 to 9 minutes and checks that every available feature is taught once or listed under guideOnly.

paths.title: Foundations
paths.summary: Everyone starts here: the window, projects, objects, your first P&ID, lists, working together and Alex.

paths.title: Process and piping
paths.summary: From the process flow diagram to a checked P&ID, its line list and reusable designs.

paths.title: Instrumentation and safety
paths.summary: Instruments, loops, hookups, datasheets, the cause and effect matrix, SIFs and alarms.

paths.title: Electrical and wiring
paths.summary: Cabinets, cables and terminals, wiring at scale, single line and circuit diagrams.

paths.title: Documents and project control
paths.summary: Documents and revisions, review and markups, branches, workflows and dashboards, import and export.

paths.title: Configuration and administration
paths.summary: The company library, catalogs and modules, people and access, integrations and Alex's automation.

courses.title: Getting started with E1
courses.summary: Open E1, sign in and find your way around the window, its menus, places and settings.
courses.outcome: You can open E1 anywhere, sign in safely and find every part of the window.

courses.title: Projects and the explorer
courses.summary: Start on Sample E1, create projects, and organize sections, folders and 2D spaces in the explorer.
courses.outcome: You can open, create and organize projects and find anything in the explorer.

courses.title: Objects, attributes and tags
courses.summary: The single source of truth: create objects, fill in attributes, tag them and relate them.
courses.outcome: You can create clean, uniquely tagged objects with their attributes and relationships.

courses.title: Your first P&ID
courses.summary: Draw on a 2D space: place symbols, connect pipes and signals, tag, annotate and print.
courses.outcome: You can draw a small, tagged P&ID over two 2D spaces and print it as PDF.

courses.title: Lists, queries and Excel
courses.summary: Build any list from the model, edit it like a spreadsheet and exchange it with Excel.
courses.outcome: You can build, filter, edit and export any list, and update the model from Excel.

courses.title: Working together
courses.summary: Work live with your team: history and undo, chat and mentions, tasks, the Inbox and attachments.
courses.outcome: You can work with others in one project, follow changes and hand over work.

courses.title: Working with Alex
courses.summary: Let Alex, the AI co-engineer, review your drawing, suggest the next step and change the project safely.
courses.outcome: You can use Alex's review, take or leave its suggestions and let it work under your name.

courses.title: Process design: from PFD to P&ID
courses.summary: Take a PFD with its heat and material balance to a P&ID, with pipelines, the line list and the checks.
courses.outcome: You can turn a PFD into a checked P&ID and keep its line list in step.

courses.title: Reusable designs: patterns, modules and symbols
courses.summary: Reuse proven designs as patterns and modules, and make your own symbols.
courses.outcome: You can reuse designs across projects and keep them up to date.

courses.title: Instrumentation
courses.summary: Instruments and loops on the P&ID, hookups, loop diagrams, system control diagrams and the instrument index.
courses.outcome: You can keep instruments, hookups and loop diagrams as views of the same instrument objects.

courses.title: Specification datasheets
courses.summary: Fill and design specification datasheets: rows, operating cases, several tags and revision marks.
courses.outcome: You can issue specification datasheets straight from the model.

courses.title: Safety: cause and effect, SIFs and alarms
courses.summary: Keep the cause and effect matrix, safety instrumented functions and alarms in the model.
courses.outcome: You can build the safety matrix, SIFs and alarm list and issue them as documents.

courses.title: Wiring basics: cabinets, cables and terminals
courses.summary: Land a signal from the field to a cabinet terminal and get the wiring lists.
courses.outcome: You can wire signals through cabinets and produce wire and cable lists.

courses.title: Wiring at scale
courses.summary: Wire a unit from typicals, check it, route the cables and manage changes after issue.
courses.outcome: You can wire whole units, check them and control changes after issue.

courses.title: Single line and circuit diagrams
courses.summary: Draw the cable network on a single line diagram and make circuit diagrams from the same objects.
courses.outcome: You can produce single line and circuit diagrams from the model.

courses.title: Documents and revisions
courses.summary: Make documents from the model, issue revisions with sign-off and issue the deliverable set.
courses.outcome: You can make, revise, sign off and issue every document of a project.

courses.title: Review and markups
courses.summary: Redline a 2D space, answer markups and run review rounds inside and outside E1.
courses.outcome: You can run a review round from markup to closed comment.

courses.title: Branches
courses.summary: Change a design on a branch, pull, push, ask for review and hand over branch packages.
courses.outcome: You can work on a branch and bring it safely back to main.

courses.title: Statuses, workflows and dashboards
courses.summary: Track the work: statuses and holds, workflows with criteria and approvals, dashboards and progress.
courses.outcome: You can run a project's workflow and report its progress.

courses.title: Import and export
courses.summary: Bring existing P&IDs and lists into E1 and hand them over: DEXPI, CAD, PDF and Excel.
courses.outcome: You can bring an existing plant into E1 and hand data over to other tools.

courses.title: The company library and project setup
courses.summary: Configuration: classes, attributes, shapes and relationships, the company library, project settings and document setup.
courses.outcome: You can set up the library and a project's rules and document setup.

courses.title: Catalogs, content packages and library modules
courses.summary: Approved product catalogs, content packages and standards, and modules offered to your projects.
courses.outcome: You can manage catalogs, packages and company modules.

courses.title: People, licenses and access
courses.summary: Invite people, assign licenses and roles, set up groups and see who did what.
courses.outcome: You can run an organization's people, licenses and permissions.

courses.title: Enterprise: your own cloud and integrations
courses.summary: E1 in your own Azure, company sign-on, tokens and the API, webhooks, message queues and security monitoring.
courses.outcome: You can run E1 in your own cloud and connect it to your company's systems.

courses.title: Alex for your company: conventions and assistants
courses.summary: Teach Alex your company's conventions and automate routine work with stored and automated assistants.
courses.outcome: You can make Alex follow your standards and automate routine engineering work.

guideOnly.note: Features of the website, not of E1: taught by the user guides only.
